LanguageData.wils.care.practice_earn_help: Complete care work to earn career experience. Specialist work also builds experience in its own specialty.
LanguageData.wils.care.healer_help: Provides routine community care. The entry role is called Nurse once the colony has assigned its first Doctor.
LanguageData.wils.care.doctor_help: Works as a qualified medical practitioner and continues routine community care.
LanguageData.wils.care.specialist.counselor_help: Provides supportive counseling and can encourage reconciliation after a quarrel.
LanguageData.wils.care.specialist.midwife_help: Provides specialist care during pregnancy and birth.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_CareDisabled: Check-ups are switched off in mod settings.
